property_summary: For any caller and any arguments, a call to setL1BlockValues never changes c.basefee() (it is either reverted by the depositor gate or is a no-op), so c.basefee() remains 0; the mutant stores _basefee, so a successful call from the depositor address makes c.basefee() != 0.
change_summary: Insert assignment basefee = _basefee; so after a successful call, basefee reflects the passed value instead of staying 0.
